source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 11: The Passive Voice

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.explanation_long: Passive Present Simple: S + am/is/are + V3. Reports = plural → are.
starter.ielts_tip: Passive: S + be + V3. Active: S + V + O.

starter.stem: The new policy ___ announced by the government last week.
starter.explanation_long: Passive Past Simple: S + was/were + V3. Policy = singular → was.

starter.stem: Solar energy ___ used in many countries around the world.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: be (bare), been (past participle of be)

starter.stem: Air pollution ___ be reduced through better technology.
starter.explanation_short: Modal + be + V3: can be reduced.
starter.explanation_long: Passive with modal: S + modal + be + V3. Can be reduced = có thể được giảm.
starter.feedback_wrong: Modal + be + V3 = passive with modal.

starter.stem: A new recycling system ___ being developed right now.
starter.explanation_short: Present Continuous Passive: is being developed.
starter.explanation_long: Passive Present Continuous: S + am/is/are + being + V3. System = singular → is.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Present Continuous Passive: is being + V3
starter.feedback_wrong: Passive Continuous: S + be + being + V3.
starter.ielts_tip: is/are + being + V3 = Present Continuous Passive.

starter.stem: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: Climate change is studied by scientists.
starter.correct_answer: Climate change is studied by scientists.
starter.explanation_short: Passive: S + be + V3 (+ by agent).
starter.explanation_long: 'Is studied' = passive. Subject nhận hành động. 'By scientists' = agent.
starter.feedback_wrong: Passive: S + be + V3 + by + agent.
starter.ielts_tip: Passive = subject nhận hành động. Active = subject làm hành động.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: các option khác đều active

starter.stem: Many trees ___ planted in the community park last year.
starter.explanation_long: Passive Past: S + was/were + V3. Trees = plural → were planted.

starter.stem: New environmental laws ___ been introduced this year.
starter.explanation_short: Laws (plural) + Present Perfect Passive: have been introduced.
starter.explanation_long: Passive Present Perfect: S + have/has + been + V3. Laws = plural → have.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Present Perfect Passive: have been + V3
starter.feedback_wrong: have/has + been + V3 = Present Perfect Passive.
starter.ielts_tip: have/has + been + V3 = Present Perfect Passive.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The waste is dispose of by the recycling company.'
starter.explanation_short: Passive: is + V3: is disposed of.
starter.explanation_long: Passive cần V3: dispose → disposed. 'Is dispose' = sai.
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 Passive cần V3: is disposed of
starter.ielts_tip: Passive: be + V3. Không dùng V1.

starter.stem: Water ___ polluted by industrial waste in many developing countries.
starter.explanation_long: Passive: Water + is + V3. Water = uncountable → is.

build_up.stem: Millions of tons of plastic ___ dumped into the ocean every year.
build_up.explanation_short: Millions of tons (plural) + mỗi năm → Present Passive: are dumped.
build_up.explanation_long: Passive Present: are + V3. 'Every year' = habitual → Present.

build_up.stem: Greenhouse gas emissions should ___ significantly to prevent climate change.
build_up.explanation_short: Modal + be + V3: should be reduced.
build_up.explanation_long: Passive with should: should + be + V3. Should be reduced = nên được giảm.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ should + be + V3: should be reduced

build_up.stem: Since 2010, over 1000 species ___ been classified as endangered.
build_up.explanation_short: Species (plural ở đây) + since 2010 → have been classified.
build_up.explanation_long: Present Perfect Passive: have + been + V3. Since = present perfect trigger.
build_up.feedback_wrong: Since + have/has + been + V3 = Present Perfect Passive.
build_up.ielts_tip: Since/For + have been + V3 = Present Perfect Passive.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The forest was destroyed from illegal logging activities.'
options: Sai: from → by (passive agent dùng by)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: from → by (passive agent dùng by)
build_up.explanation_short: Passive agent dùng by, không from: was destroyed BY.

options: The government implemented new environmental policies.
New environmental policies were implemented by the government.
The government has been implementing new policies.
The government will implement new policies.
build_up.correct_answer: New environmental policies were implemented by the government.
build_up.explanation_short: were implemented = passive. Subject nhận hành động.
build_up.explanation_long: Passive: 'were implemented' + 'by the government'. Subject nhận hành động.
build_up.feedback_wrong: Passive: S + be + V3 + by agent.
build_up.ielts_tip: Passive: subject nhận hành động. Active: subject làm hành động.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option C (has been implementing) = active continuous

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Toxic chemicals are release into rivers by factories.'
build_up.explanation_long: Passive cần V3: release → released. 'Are release' = sai.
build_up.ielts_tip: Passive: be + V3. Phải dùng past participle.

build_up.stem: The new waste management system ___ be installed next month.
build_up.explanation_short: Next month + passive → Future Passive: will be installed.
build_up.explanation_long: Future Passive: will + be + V3. Will be installed = sẽ được lắp đặt.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The data is been analyzed by the research team right now.'
options: Sai: is been → is being (continuous passive)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: is been → is being (continuous passive)
build_up.explanation_short: Continuous Passive: is BEING analyzed (không is been).
build_up.explanation_long: Present Continuous Passive: S + is/are + being + V3. 'Is been' = sai.

build_up.stem: Endangered animals must ___ by strict conservation laws.
build_up.explanation_short: must + be + V3: must be protected.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 must + be + V3: must be protected

build_up.stem: Several environmental projects ___ been funded by international organizations.
build_up.explanation_long: Present Perfect Passive: have + been + V3. Projects = plural → have.
build_up.ielts_tip: have/has + been + V3 = Present Perfect Passive.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The ozone layer is being damage by harmful chemicals, and marine ecosystems are also being threaten.'
options: The ozone layer is being damage
challenge.correct_answer: The ozone layer is being damage
challenge.explanation_short: being + V3: being damaged (không being damage).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'being damage' → 'being damaged' (V3). Lớp 2: 'being threaten' → 'being threatened'. Cả A và D sai, A trước.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (being threaten) cũng sai

challenge.stem: Chọn câu Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT (academic passive):
options: Scientists have conducted extensive research on climate change.
Extensive research on climate change has been conducted.
Climate change research is conduct by scientists.
Scientists conduct research on climate change.
challenge.correct_answer: Extensive research on climate change has been conducted.
challenge.explanation_short: Academic writing ưu tiên passive khi agent không quan trọng.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'has been conducted' = academic passive chuẩn. Lớp 2: Agent (scientists) không quan trọng bằng research → bỏ 'by scientists'. Lớp 3: 'is conduct' sai (thiếu V3).
challenge.feedback_wrong: Academic passive: bỏ agent khi không quan trọng.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: Passive khi focus vào action, không phải doer.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A đúng nhưng active, ít academic

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Renewable energy sources should be promote by governments, and fossil fuels must be gradually phase out.'
challenge.explanation_short: should be + V3: should be promoted (không promote).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'should be promote' → 'should be promoted' (V3). Lớp 2: 'phase out' → 'phased out' (V3). Cả B và D sai, B trước.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (phase out → phased out) cũng sai

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho đoạn academic:
options: People must protect endangered species before they disappear.
Endangered species must be protected before they disappear.
Endangered species must protected before they disappear.
Endangered species must be protect before they disappear.
challenge.correct_answer: Endangered species must be protected before they disappear.
challenge.explanation_short: Academic: passive focus vào object. must + be + V3.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'must be protected' = chuẩn modal passive. Lớp 2: Academic ưu tiên passive. Lớp 3: 'must protected' thiếu be. Lớp 4: 'must be protect' thiếu -ed.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 must be protected = academic passive chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: must + be + V3. Academic ưu tiên passive.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C thiếu be, option D thiếu -ed

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'Since 2015, many environmental policies ___ [A] and significant progress ___ [B].'
options: [A] have been implemented / [B] has been made
[A] have been implemented / [B] have been made
[A] has been implemented / [B] has been made
challenge.correct_answer: [A] have been implemented / [B] has been made
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'policies' = plural → 'have been implemented'. Lớp 2: 'progress' = uncountable → 'has been made'. Since = Present Perfect trigger.
challenge.feedback_wrong: Plural → have been. Uncountable → has been.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (have been made) sai vì progress = uncountable → has

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While new recycling methods are been developed, existing waste management systems are being improved simultaneously.'
challenge.explanation_short: Continuous passive: are BEING developed (không are been).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'are been' → 'are being' (continuous passive). Lớp 2: 'are being improved' = đúng.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D trông có vẻ sai nhưng are being improved = đúng

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: The government should implement stricter regulations to reduce pollution levels.
Stricter regulations should be implemented to reduce pollution levels.
Stricter regulations should implemented to reduce pollution levels.
Pollution levels should be reduce by stricter regulations.
challenge.correct_answer: Stricter regulations should be implemented to reduce pollution levels.
challenge.explanation_short: Academic: passive focus vào policy. should + be + V3.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: should be implemented = chuẩn. Lớp 2: Academic ưu tiên passive khi subject = policy/regulation. Lớp 3: 'should implemented' thiếu be. Lớp 4: 'should be reduce' thiếu -d.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 should be implemented = academic passive chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: should + be + V3. Academic ưu tiên passive cho policy.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A đúng nhưng active

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The report was publish in 2023, and its findings have been widely discuss by environmental experts.'
challenge.explanation_short: was + V3: was published (không was publish).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'was publish' → 'was published' (V3). Lớp 2: 'widely discuss' → 'widely discussed' (V3). Cả A và C sai, A trước.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (discuss → discussed) cũng sai

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 3: 'Ai chịu trách nhiệm bảo vệ môi trường?' — Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: The environment should be protected by everyone
The environment should be protect by governments.
Everyone should be protecting the environment.
challenge.correct_answer: The environment should be protected by everyone, including governments and individuals.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: should be protected = passive chuẩn. Lớp 2: 'by everyone, including...' = comprehensive answer. Lớp 3: 'should be protect' sai (thiếu -ed).
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 3: Passive + by agent = band 6.0+.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A đúng nhưng active, ít sophisticated

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'Forests [A] are being destroy at an alarming rate, endangered species [B] has been threaten, and natural habitats [C] must be preserve for future generations.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] destroy → destroyed. [B] has → have (species = plural). [C] preserve → preserved.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'being destroy' → 'being destroyed' (V3). Lớp 2: [B] 'species has' → 'species have' (species = plural ở đây) + 'threaten' → 'threatened'. Lớp 3: [C] 'be preserve' → 'be preserved' (V3).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] destroyed | [B] have been threatened | [C] be preserved!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] being + V3. [B] plural → have + V3. [C] be + V3.
challenge.ielts_tip: Passive: be + V3. Luôn dùng past participle.
